name: native-ralph-loop
description: Worked example of the native ralph refinement loop: an agent edits the workspace toward the current focus areas, a tool-suppressed chat node assesses whether the focus areas are satisfied, a transform increments the iteration counter, and a conditional either exits (done OR counter >= max) or back-edges to the agent for another pass. Nodes reference only profile aliases (editor, assessor), so the same graph runs under both the Claude-subscription and open-weight configurations by repointing the alias bindings.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: mission
inputs.description: The high-level refinement goal the editor agent works toward each pass.

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum number of refinement passes before the loop exits unconditionally.

inputs.name: iteration
inputs.description: The loop counter. Declared as an input with default 0 so it exists and is numeric before the first increment.

nodes.label: Editor (agent)
nodes.description: Reads RALPH.md, focus-areas.md, and gaps.md from the workspace and makes the smallest correct edit toward the top focus area.

nodes.label: Assessor (chat)
nodes.description: Tool-suppressed reasoning: judges whether the focus areas are satisfied and emits a structured {done, notes} result.

done.description: True when the focus areas are satisfied and the loop should exit.

nodes.label: Increment iteration counter
nodes.description: Adds 1 to the iteration counter after each assess pass.

nodes.label: Loop or exit
nodes.description: Encodes (done? OR counter >= max?) as two condition entries that both route to the exit port (first-match wins); the default routes back into the loop.

nodes.label: Loop summary (terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal node with no outgoing edges. Records the final loop status so the walk ends cleanly and the exit port is reachable for connectivity validation.
